notes.title: A new visual novel from our writer!
notes.notes:
This time, our writer (a guy who goes by the name Alkinoy) decided to try his hand at a supernatural thriller. He drew a lot of inspiration from John Constantine comics, and what came out of it is... well, this. It’s a very mature story with strong language, dark humor, some weird player trolling, and moments inspired by the visual novel Doki-Doki.

If that sounds interesting, hurry and grab "Blind Man's Sun" — it’s on sale until October 5th!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3201610/Blind_Mans_Sun/]Link to novel page.[/url]
